column1: # Genome-wide TraDIS of Salmonella enterica serovar Typhi (Ty2) in humanized mice.
# Nickerson KP et al. (2019) Cell Host Microbe 26:245-258. PMID 31447308. DOI 10.1016/j.chom.2019.08.001
# Source: supplementary mmc4.xlsx, sheet 'tradis_comparison.R' (4,589 genes) and 'FDR<0.05' (74 genes).
# effect_log2 = -logFC, so POSITIVE means the mutant was depleted in the animal.
# q_value is the authors' own FDR. The attenuation call uses their cutoff, q <= 0.05; it is not retuned here.
# Keyed on BOTH the current RefSeq tag (locus_tag) and the legacy SL1344_#### tag
#   (old_locus_tag), because the bundled compilation is keyed on the legacy tags.
# Transfer Ty2 -> SL1344: identical RefSeq protein accession, else unique gene symbol, else a single
#   SL1344 protein at >= 90% identity. 3,034 of 4,868 SL1344 genes (62.3%) receive a value, and 47 of
#   the 74 significant genes transfer. ABSENCE OF A VALUE IS NOT EVIDENCE OF NO PHENOTYPE.
# The 27 significant genes that do not transfer are dominated by structures Typhimurium does not share:
#   the 10-gene Vi antigen locus (tviABCDE, vexABCDE), 5 O-antigen rfb genes and 4 waa outer-core genes.
# This screen is NOT used to license an in vitro 'dispensable' call: the viable mutant existed in Typhi,
#   not in Typhimurium, and that inference does not cross the serovar boundary.
